# North Station: summary of 2024

North Station pumped 1.9 million cubic metres in 2024. HP40-1183 ran for 6,100 hours and HP40-2291 for 2,300 hours, as HP40-1183 was kept on duty for most of the year.

No seal failures were recorded in 2024. The only stoppage was a four-hour power cut on 17 November, when both pumps were off.

For 2025 the site engineer, Tomasz Wren, plans to share the duty more evenly between the two pumps.
